conceded_f3_entries_by_channel.sentence: Conceded final-third entry passes, share by channel (defending team's frame): def left = completed open-play passes by the opponent starting outside the final third and ending in the final third, end location in the acting team's right lateral third; def centre = completed open-play passes by the opponent starting outside the final third and ending in the final third, end location in the central lateral third; def right = completed open-play passes by the opponent starting outside the final third and ending in the final third, end location in the acting team's left lateral third. Each part is a share of the three-part total. Window: first and second half, both teams at eleven, goal difference at most one.

conceded_f3_entries_wide_share.sentence: Conceded final-third entry passes, wide share: wide = completed open-play passes by the opponent starting outside the final third and ending in the final third, end location in the acting team's left lateral third plus completed open-play passes by the opponent starting outside the final third and ending in the final third, end location in the acting team's right lateral third; centre = completed open-play passes by the opponent starting outside the final third and ending in the final third, end location in the central lateral third. Each part is a share of the two-part total. Window: first and second half, both teams at eleven, goal difference at most one.

conceded_box_entries_by_origin_channel.sentence: Conceded penalty-area entry passes, share by origin channel (defending team's frame): def left = completed open-play passes by the opponent starting outside the penalty-area rectangle and ending in the penalty-area rectangle, start location in the acting team's right lateral third; def centre = completed open-play passes by the opponent starting outside the penalty-area rectangle and ending in the penalty-area rectangle, start location in the central lateral third; def right = completed open-play passes by the opponent starting outside the penalty-area rectangle and ending in the penalty-area rectangle, start location in the acting team's left lateral third. Each part is a share of the three-part total. Window: first and second half, both teams at eleven, goal difference at most one.

conceded_shots_inside_box_share.sentence: Conceded open-play shots, share from inside the penalty-area rectangle: inside box = open-play shots by the opponent, start location inside the penalty-area rectangle; outside box = open-play shots by the opponent, start location outside the penalty-area rectangle. Each part is a share of the two-part total. Window: first and second half, both teams at eleven, goal difference at most one.

defensive_actions_by_pitch_third.sentence: Recorded defensive actions, share by pitch third (team's own frame): own third = recorded defensive actions (ground defending duel records, interception-tagged events, fouls committed; each event once) by the team, start location in the acting team's own third; middle third = recorded defensive actions (ground defending duel records, interception-tagged events, fouls committed; each event once) by the team, start location in the middle third; opposition third = recorded defensive actions (ground defending duel records, interception-tagged events, fouls committed; each event once) by the team, start location in the opposition third. Each part is a share of the three-part total. Window: first and second half, both teams at eleven, goal difference at most one.

high_zone_defensive_action_share.sentence: High-zone defensive actions as a share of those actions plus opponent pass attempts started in the opponent's own 60%: high zone defensive actions = recorded defensive actions (ground defending duel records, interception-tagged events, fouls committed; each event once) by the team starting in the zone at least 40% of the pitch length from the acting team's own goal line; opponent own 60 passes = open-play pass attempts by the opponent starting in the passing team's own 60% of the pitch length. Each part is a share of the two-part total. Window: first and second half, both teams at eleven, goal difference at most one.

Each part is a share of the three-part total. Window: first and second half, both teams at eleven, goal difference at most one.

conceded_shots_inside_box_share_sb.sentence: Conceded open-play shots, share from inside the penalty-area rectangle: inside box = open-play shots by the opponent, start location inside the penalty-area rectangle; outside box = open-play shots by the opponent, start location outside the penalty-area rectangle. Each part is a share of the two-part total. Window: first and second half, both teams at eleven, goal difference at most one.
